asked: hi Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /root/axf-builds/app-voice-commands/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches (Brett, Nov 3 2026): a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. An UPGRADE (e.g. Opus → Fable) needs Brett's approval: when you reach one, run `node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs request-upgrade <id> <phase>`, ask once, and stop. Never approve a model switch upgrade yourself (no `act approve` on an upgrade), never relaunch on a higher model. Voice commands (Brett, Nov 4 2026): when this build adds, ports or changes an app, its project.manifest.json must say framework.forFramework (true = for the framework's own development; apps in this repo default to true). A forFramework app's every API / MCP / CLI command and web action needs voice phrases: run `node framework/cli/voice-commands.mjs generate <app> --write` after adding or changing commands and `node framework/cli/voice-commands.mjs check` before the PR (CI fails on a command without phrases). Hand-tune phrases by marking a command `"source": "authored"` in src/assets/voice-command/<app>.json.
